input.jobDescription:
Senior Software Engineer at RemoteFirst Co

RemoteFirst Co is a fully distributed company with no physical offices. All 200+ employees work from home across 30 countries.

This role is 100% remote. We require availability within UTC-8 to UTC+2 for core collaboration hours (10am-2pm UTC).

What you'll work on:
- Building and scaling our event-driven microservices architecture
- Node.js services and TypeScript throughout the stack
- Apache Kafka for message streaming
- PostgreSQL and Redis for data storage
- Async-first communication: decisions in writing, meetings are a last resort

Required:
- Node.js and TypeScript
- Distributed systems design
- Kafka or RabbitMQ
- PostgreSQL
- Experience working remotely (3+ years)
- Excellent written communication skills

We do not sponsor visas for this role.

Apply at remotefirst.co/jobs
